name: pnp-sp-fx-aces-PrimaryTextCard-WorkIQ-TodaySummary
title: Today with Work IQ (PrimaryTextCard-WorkIQ-TodaySummary)
shortDescription: Viva Connections card showing a Work IQ-generated 'what's relevant today' summary, via a C# Azure Function OBO proxy.
longDescription: A Primary Text Card ACE for the Viva Connections dashboard that shows a short, Work IQ-generated 'what's relevant to you today' summary for the signed-in user, pulled from their files, meetings, and messages. The Quick View expands into the underlying referenced items. Calls the Work IQ REST Chat API through a C# Azure Function proxy that performs an On-Behalf-Of token exchange and caches responses to control Copilot Credits spend.
